meta.name: shinka-setup
meta.description: Create ShinkaEvolve task scaffolds from a target directory and task description, producing `evaluate.py` and `initial.<ext>` (multi-language). Use when asked to set up new ShinkaEvolve tasks, evaluation harnesses, or baseline programs for ShinkaEvolve.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 ShinkaEvolve 创建任务脚手架和评估代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速生成 ShinkaEvolve 任务的初始代码和评估脚本。
copy.tagline_en: Create task scaffolds and evaluation harnesses for ShinkaEvolve
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate initial code and evaluation scripts for ShinkaEvolve tasks.

howto.what: 根据用户描述的任务和目标目录，自动生成 ShinkaEvolve 所需的评估脚本 evaluate.py 和初始程序 initial.<ext>（支持多种语言）。
howto.when: 当用户要求设置新的 ShinkaEvolve 任务、评估框架或基线程序，且工作目录中缺少 evaluate.py 和 initial.<ext> 时。

say.text: 帮我为排序算法创建 ShinkaEvolve 任务脚手架，语言用 Python。
say.note: 会生成 initial.py 和 evaluate.py。

howto.what_en: Generates ShinkaEvolve task scaffolds (evaluate.py and initial.<ext>) based on user's task description and target directory. Supports multiple programming languages.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to set up a new ShinkaEvolve task, evaluation harness, or baseline program, and evaluate.py/initial.<ext> are absent.

say_en.text: Create a ShinkaEvolve task scaffold for sorting algorithm in Python.
Set up a C++ initial program template for code optimization.
